terms.comment: Classically a repositōrium is a stand or tray for dishes (Petr., Sen.), and in the Historia Augusta a cabinet for keeping things (Lewis & Short).

sources: Lewis & Short: repositorium · Lewis & Short: datum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 260, 300, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
